score.question: What does the 🔥 number mean?
score.usual: It shows how many times more views a video got than that account normally gets. "Normally" = the middle value (median) of its ~20 most recent posts, not counting this one.
score.reach: If we have not checked that account’s recent posts, we compare views with followers instead (views ÷ followers).
score.caveat: Views show attention, not sales. Use the 🔥 to find ideas worth studying, then test them yourself.
score.minViews: It also needs real views: Breakout needs 10K+ views, Strong 5K+. Views ÷ followers only counts for accounts with 1K+ followers.

read.title: First, I read your brief
read.body: I pull out exactly what to look for. Your own words drive everything from here.

search.title: Then I search every platform
search.body: Each of your keywords runs on every platform you picked, sorted by what’s most-liked and on top.

filter.title: Next, I keep only what fits
filter.body: Words on your avoid list are dropped before you ever see them.
filter.ai: AI also reads every caption and removes anything that isn’t about your product.

score.title: And I score every keeper
score.body: Each video gets a 🔥 score: how far it beat the account’s usual views, not just raw views.
score.note: A clip that blows past its own account’s normal is one worth learning from, no matter how big the creator is.
